# Activity > Shared static and collapsible activity anatomy with bounded, scrollable detail content. This file matches the installed `activity` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/activity.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/activity.md`. ## npm dependencies - `lucide-react@^1.47.0` ## Registry dependencies - `collapsible` - `core` - `effects` - `live-status` - `scroll-area` - `swap` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/activity-knobs`: `activityKnobs`, types `ActivityKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/activity`: `Activity`, `ActivityRow`, `ActivityTrigger`, `ActivityIcon`, `ActivityTitle`, `ActivityStatus`, `ActivityContent`, `ActivityDetail`, `ActivityDetailLabel`, `ActivityDetailContent`, types `ActivityState`, `ActivityKind`, `ActivityDetailFormat`, `ActivityProps`, `ActivityRowProps`, `ActivityTriggerProps`, `ActivityIconProps`, `ActivityTitleProps`, `ActivityStatusProps`, `ActivityContentProps`, `ActivityDetailProps`, `ActivityDetailLabelProps`, `ActivityDetailTone`, `ActivityDetailContentProps` ## Composition ### Static activity ```tsx ``` ### Collapsible activity ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { BookOpen, Globe, Radio, Search, SquareTerminal } from "lucide-react"; import type { ReactNode } from "react"; import { useEffect, useState } from "react"; import { Activity, ActivityContent, ActivityDetail, ActivityDetailContent, ActivityDetailLabel, ActivityIcon, ActivityRow, ActivityStatus, ActivityTitle, ActivityTrigger, } from "@/components/control-ui/activity"; import { SourceBadge } from "@/components/control-ui/source-badge"; import { Spinner } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/spinner"; import type { TimelineState } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/timeline"; import { Timeline, TimelineContent, TimelineIndicator, TimelineItem, TimelineSeparator, TimelineTitle, } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/timeline"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; ); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `activity` - `chevron`: `data-icon-dir` (`inline`) - `content` - `content-grid` - `detail` - `detail-content`: `data-format` (`code` | `text`), `data-tone` (`danger` | `neutral`) - `detail-label` - `icon`: `data-status-icon` - `root`: `data-activity-kind` (`default` | `reasoning` | `signal` | `tool`), `data-activity-name` (any value), `data-activity-state` (`error` | `pending` | `running` | `success` | `waiting`) - `row` - `status`: `data-kind` (`default` | `reasoning` | `signal` | `tool`), `data-status` (`error` | `pending` | `running` | `success` | `waiting`) - `title` - `trigger` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### activity - `--cui-activity-row-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)` - `--cui-activity-trigger-radius`: `var(--radius-control)` - `--cui-activity-trigger-hover-background`: `var(--hover-fill)` - `--cui-activity-code-background`: `oklch(from var(--muted) l c h / 0.5)` - `--cui-activity-code-radius`: `var(--radius-control)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/kits/activity - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/activity.json
